firstPlayerRule: Whoever last visited a port in real life starts and takes the first-player marker. Turns proceed clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The first player moves the game-turn marker forward at the start of each round.
On everyone's first turn, skip phases 1 and 2 and begin with phase 3, Sending Ships Out.
